summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 66,666,667 ordinary shares at $0.45 per share, raising approximately $30.0 million ($28.2 million net of placement agent fees). The shares are listed on Nasdaq under INVZ. Titan Partners Securities LLC acts as sole placement agent on a best-efforts basis. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown with no special-situation characteristics such as control, premium, or restructuring. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a specified special situation category.
